name: Devotional
description: Short scripture-anchored reflections — a verse, a thought, a takeaway. Distinct from raw prayer in that the listener is being TAUGHT something rooted in a passage, not just praying through it. Best for channels that want a steady daily-devotion cadence ('today's verse', 'a thought from Psalm 23'). Pair with calm nature / candle / sunrise B-Roll.
tagline: A verse. A thought. A breath.
exampleTopics: What the Beatitudes Teach Us About Quiet Strength
Trusting When You Can't See the Path
audienceHint: Christians who want a 3-7 minute scripture-grounded reflection alongside their morning coffee or before bed.
scriptContext: Anchor every devotional in ONE specific passage. Open with the verse spoken aloud, unpack it in 2-3 short reflections, end with a single takeaway the listener can carry through the day. Avoid theological tangents; stay practical and pastoral.
